messages.author: b6a507150c85ca93
messages.subject: RRO 3.2.2 and dplyr package update
parts:
I ran into an issue with RRO 3.2.2 and dplyr - when using a command of that package, the R engine was crashing. I also downloaded R 3.2.2 and then updated the dplyr package today, and the issue appears to be fixed with the updated package. I understand the need for RRO to have a fixed package repository, but occasionally there will be bugs and other issues that come up if a package is not updated correctly at the time of the new release. In any case, what will the the timetable for RRO package updates?

Regards,

Jason Frederick
